messages.subject: inla.exe-Entry Point Not Found
parts:
Hi,

I am fitting a shared components model of three variables (k = 3). When I fit the glmm it works without any problem and I get the posterior estimates of the model. However, when I try to include the Intrinsic Multivariate CAR (IMCAR) I run into inla.exe-Entry Point Not Found (The procedure entry point Rf_translateCharFP could not be located in the dynamic link library C:\Program Files\R\-4.0.2\library\grDevices\libs\x64\grDevices.dll.). Analysis code is 

library(maptools)
library(rgdal)
library(spdep)
library(INLA)
library(INLAMSM)

kenyacount<-readOGR("C:/Users/Moses Lwanda Ouma/Documents/Year2/Research Project/Kenya_Shape_file/Shapefiles",layer="County")

merged<-read_excel(paste0(BASEDIR, file = "Sharecomponents.xlsx"))


plot(merged)

library(spdep)

##Compute adjacency matrix, as nb object 'adj' and sparse matrix 'W'

adj <- poly2nb(kenyacount)
W <- as(nb2mat(adj, style = "B", zero.policy = T), "Matrix")
plot(merged)

 ## Compute expected cases
   HIV_PEVV <- sum(merged$positive) / sum(merged$obs_HIV)
 merged$HIV_EXXP <- HIV_PEVV * merged$obs_HIV
 
 # SMR
  merged$HIV_SIRR <- merged$positive / merged$HIV_EXXP
  
  
## Proportion of physical violence
  PHY_PREV <- sum(merged$expphy) /sum(merged$obs_phy)
  
  # Compute expected cases
merged$PHY_EXP <- PHY_PREV * merged$obs_phy
# SMR
merged$PHY_SIRR <- merged$expphy / merged$PHY_EXP

 # Proportion of sexual violence
SEX_PREV <- sum(merged$expsex) /sum(merged$obs_sex)

# Compute expected cases
merged$SEX_EXP <- SEX_PREV * merged$obs_sex
# SMR
merged$SEX_SIRR <- merged$expsex / merged$SEX_EXP


## Creating a data frame

d<- data.frame(OBS = c(merged$positive, merged$expphy, merged$expsex),
                 PERIOD = c(rep("HIV_PEVV", 47), rep("PHY_PREV", 47), rep("SEX_PREV", 47)),
                 EXP = c(merged$HIV_EXXP, merged$PHY_EXP, merged$SEX_EXP))

## County-period index
d$idx <- 1:length(d$OBS)

##Number of variables (i.e., periods)
k<-3
## Define bivariate latent effect
model.indimcar <- inla.rgeneric.define(inla.rgeneric.IMCAR.model,
                                        list(k = k, W = W))

## Definition of the new latent done in a wraper
##Prescribing constraints so that the random effects sum to zero

A <- kronecker(Diagonal(k, 1), Matrix(1, ncol = nrow(W), nrow = 1))
e = rep(0, k)

IIMGLMM <- inla(OBS ~ 0 + PERIOD + f(idx, model = model.indimcar1,extraconstr = list(A = as.matrix(A), e = e)), ##GLMM runs well
                data = d,
                E = EXP, family = "poisson", control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE),
                control.compute = list(dic = TRUE), verbose = T)

##Extracting Random effects from the GLMM model
kenyacount$mean.glmm <- IIMCAR$summary.random$idx[47+1:47+1:47, 2]
kenyacount$median.glmm <- IIMCAR$summary.random$idx[47+1:47+1:47, 5]
kenyacount$lowerquantile.glmm <- IIMCAR$summary.random$idx[47+1:47+1:47, 4]
kenyacount$upperquantile.glmm <- IIMCAR$summary.random$idx[47+1:47+1:47, 6]


IIMCAR <- inla(OBS ~ 0 + PERIOD + f(idx, model = model.indimcar, extraconstr = list(A = as.matrix(A), e = e)), ##CAR is the one giving the above error
                data = d,
                E = EXP, family = "poisson", control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE),
                control.compute = list(dic = TRUE), verbose = T)

Has anyone run into such an error? I will appreciate if I can get some light to this problem.
